title: Refine Metrics tab operator dashboard
summary: Refined the Metrics tab into an operator-first dashboard with additive coverage, attention, route reason group, throughput, and worker posture fields plus WebView rendering for the existing five subtabs.
reason: Operators need Metrics to answer daily health, anomaly, route-decision, storage, throughput, and worker handoff questions without turning the tab into an all-time evidence report.
behavior_before: Metrics exposed all-time aggregate route, storage, production, worker, and evidence summaries, with sparse formatting and no backend-authored attention hierarchy.
behavior_after: Metrics keeps the same read-only route and source/backfill boundaries while adding coverage, attention_items, route_mix.reason_groups, production.throughput, and workers.posture. The WebView now leads with Completed/Remux/Encode/Net Saved/Output Written/Pending Publish KPIs, attention and coverage tables, route reason groups, clearer storage columns, throughput rows, explicit worker units, and an Open Workers handoff.
tests_added: Updated tests/python/desktop/test_metrics_feature.py to assert coverage, attention_items, route reason groups, production throughput, worker posture, formatting hooks, storage columns, and Workers handoff.
manual_validation: $env:PYTHONPATH=(Join-Path (Get-Location) 'src'); .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static - failed on two unrelated existing non-Metrics assertions: Completed tab expects >Publish</button>; subtitle QA API routes are not referenced by shell assets.
rollback_plan: Revert the additive Metrics policy fields, the Metrics WebView partial/renderer/style changes, the Metrics feature test updates, and the generated summaries in this change packet. Existing /api/metrics/sources and /api/metrics/backfill state-writing behavior does not need data rollback because it was not changed.
notes:
Implemented additive Metrics read-model fields and operator dashboard hierarchy.
Refreshed summaries for Metrics dashboard changes.
No media policy, queue, publish/drain, rename, filesystem mutation, or Metrics source/backfill command behavior was changed.
Completed packet metadata and refreshed its summary.
